introHtml: Microwave-safe bowls, plates, and trays let your team heat up meals without transferring food to another dish. Whether you're stocking a corporate breakroom or providing catering at a company picnic, polypropylene and melamine options handle repeated reheating without warping. Add your logo with pad printing or a full-color wrap for a branded look that survives daily use.
